traceability.claimText: CQ3 is demonstrated by a single row tracing R_BUILDING_MIN_DISTANCE_12_V/A2/hasDistanceM to parameter SepDist of type Variable.

forwardQuery.description: Rule -> HAS_BODY -> DataPropertyAtom -> ATTRIBUTE_OF -> Parameter. Starts from the rule id and project, traverses HAS_BODY to the atom filtered on type = 'DataPropertyAtom', then ATTRIBUTE_OF to the parameter.
forwardQuery.cypher: MATCH (r:Rule {Rule_Id: $ruleId, project: $project}) MATCH (r)-[:HAS_BODY]->(a:Atom {type: 'DataPropertyAtom'}) MATCH (a)-[:ATTRIBUTE_OF]->(p:Parameter) RETURN p.parameterName AS parameterName, p.paramKind AS parameterKind, p.cgId AS parameterCgId

reverseQuery.description: Parameter <- ATTRIBUTE_OF <- DataPropertyAtom <- HAS_BODY <- Rule. Starts from the parameter's key, traverses ATTRIBUTE_OF backwards to the atom and HAS_BODY backwards to the rule.
reverseQuery.cypher: MATCH (p:Parameter {cgId: $parameterCgId, definitionId: $definitionId, project: $project}) MATCH (a:Atom)-[:ATTRIBUTE_OF]->(p) MATCH (r:Rule)-[:HAS_BODY]->(a) RETURN r.Rule_Id AS ruleId, a.Atom_Id AS atomId, a.type AS atomType

crossProjectIsolation.description: The same forward and reverse queries, re-run with a different project value, must return zero rows -- proving project scoping, not incidental non-collision.

scopeDisclaimer: This evidence demonstrates a populated, queryable bridge on one fixture -- it records ComputGraph structure and does not claim solver equivalence or executable design semantics. See README.md.
